simple.meaning: עָנָה (ʻânâh) appears 83 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 16 more, beginning at Genesis 15:13. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, land, Israel.
